Regression scatter plot with linear smooth

Source: R/plot_regression.R
plot_regression.Rd

Scatter plot of one or more proteins' values against an x-axis variable (e.g. time) with an overlaid linear (or other) smooth, optionally colored by a grouping variable and/or faceted by a second variable.

Usage

plot_regression(
  data,
  assay,
  x = NULL,
  color_by = NULL,
  facet_by = NULL,
  assay_col = NULL,
  value_col = NULL,
  method = "lm",
  se = TRUE,
  alpha_point = 0.7,
  palette = NULL,
  title = NULL,
  color = NULL,
  facet = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

data

A data.frame in long format, or an OlinkExperiment.

assay

Name(s) of the protein/assay(s) to plot (must match values in `assay_col`).

x

Name of the x-axis variable (e.g. "Time"). If NULL, auto-detected.

color_by, color

Optional column name to color points and fits by.

facet_by, facet

Optional column name to facet the plot by.

assay_col

Name of the assay column. If NULL, auto-detected (e.g. "Assay").

value_col

Name of the NPX value column. If NULL, auto-detected (e.g. "NPX").

method

Smoothing method passed to `ggplot2::stat_smooth()`: "lm", "loess", "gam", etc. (default "lm").

se

Logical; show confidence band around the smooth (default TRUE).

alpha_point

Alpha for the points (default 0.7).

palette

Optional color palette for `color_by`.

title

Plot title. If NULL, uses the assay name.

...

Additional arguments passed to `ggplot2::stat_smooth()`.

Value

A ggplot object.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
plot_regression(
  probc, assay = "IL6", x = "Time",
  color_by = "TreatGroup", facet_by = "TreatGroup"
)
} # }
